description: This is a Java test class named ContextTest that contains unit tests for the Context class in the OpenMRS core API. It verifies various functionalities such as authentication, session management, cache eviction, service retrieval, and user context switching, primarily aimed at ensuring the correctness of the context handling within OpenMRS.

classes.name: ContextTest
classes.description: Test class for verifying the behavior of the Context utility within the OpenMRS API, including authentication, cache management, user context, and service retrieval.

methods.name: authenticate_shouldNotAuthenticateWithNullPassword
methods.description: Tests that authenticating with a null password throws a ContextAuthenticationException.

methods.name: authenticate_shouldNotAuthenticateWithNullPasswordAndProperSystemId
methods.description: Tests that authenticating with a null password and proper system ID throws an exception.

methods.name: authenticate_shouldNotAuthenticateWithNullPasswordAndProperUsername
methods.description: Tests that authenticating with a null password and proper username throws an exception.

methods.name: authenticate_shouldNotAuthenticateWithNullUsername
methods.description: Tests that authenticating with a null username throws an exception.

methods.name: authenticate_shouldNotAuthenticateWithNullUsernameAndPassword
methods.description: Tests that authenticating with both username and password as null throws an exception.

methods.name: authenticate_shouldAuthenticateUserWithUsernameAndPassword
methods.description: Verifies that a user can be authenticated successfully with username and password.

methods.name: getLocale_shouldNotFailIfSessionHasntBeenOpened
methods.description: Ensures that getting the locale doesn't fail if the session hasn't been started.

methods.name: getUserContext_shouldFailIfSessionHasntBeenOpened
methods.description: Ensures that fetching user context without an open session throws an APIException.

methods.name: logout_shouldNotFailIfSessionHasntBeenOpenedYet
methods.description: Ensures that logout is safe to call even if the session is not open.

methods.name: isSessionOpen_shouldReturnTrueIfSessionIsClosed
methods.description: Checks that isSessionOpen returns true when the session is open and false after closing it.

methods.name: refreshAuthenticatedUser_shouldGetFreshValuesFromTheDatabase
methods.description: Verifies that refreshing the user fetches latest data from the database.

methods.name: refreshAuthenticatedUser_shouldNotUnsetUserLocation
methods.description: Ensures that user location remains intact after refresh.

methods.name: refreshAuthenticatedUser_shouldSetDefaultLocationIfLocationNull
methods.description: Checks that default location is set when user location is initially null.

methods.name: getRegisteredComponents_shouldReturnAListOfAllRegisteredBeansOfThePassedType
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of all beans of a specified type.

methods.name: getRegisteredComponents_shouldReturnAnEmptyListIfNoBeansHaveBeenRegisteredOfThePassedType
methods.description: Ensures an empty list is returned when no beans of the specified type are registered.

methods.name: getRegisteredComponent_shouldReturnBeanHaveBeenRegisteredOfThePassedTypeAndName
methods.description: Verifies that a bean registered with specific name and type can be retrieved.

methods.name: getRegisteredComponent_shouldFailIfBeanHaveBeenREgisteredOfThePassedTypeAndNameDoesntExist
methods.description: Checks that attempting to retrieve a non-existent bean throws an exception.

methods.name: getService_shouldReturnTheSameObjectWhenCalledMultipleTimesForTheSameClass
methods.description: Ensures service retrieval returns singleton instances or the same proxy instance consistent across calls.

methods.name: becomeUser_shouldChangeLocaleWhenBecomeAnotherUser
methods.description: Tests that switching user context updates locale settings accordingly.

methods.name: evictEntity_shouldClearTheEntityFromCaches
methods.description: Verifies that an entity can be evicted from both first-level and second-level caches.

methods.name: evictAllEntities_shouldClearAllEntityFromCaches
methods.description: Ensures that all entities of a specific class are evicted from the cache.

methods.name: clearEntireCache_shouldClearEntireCache
methods.description: Test that the entire cache (both first-level and second-level) is cleared, clearing all loaded entities.
